note: Set A binds several dimensions and components to the correct named elevations (North Living width 9'-11 1/2", the artwork 'SEE ARTWORK PKG' note, TV and the 3'-9 11/16" segments in West Living, MWD02 in South Bedroom, 9'-10 1/4" and P2 in North Bedroom), whereas Set B leaves most claims attached to vague entities like 'interior elevation', 'Wall section' or 'room elevation' and repeats the same dimensions. Set A does make clear errors: it repeatedly conflates 'A3 WEST' with the South Bedroom elevation, assigns 9'-2" to West Bedroom and 3'-6" to North Bedroom when those values belong to other elevations, and invents properties/conditions such as 'top trim width', 'center point X', 'upper wall' and 'presence: installed'. Set B's few solid claims (MWL01 in West Living, the 1/2"=1'-0" scale, West Living segment dimensions) are outweighed by its vague, duplicated and misbound entries (e.g. 'W2 depth 4 1/2"', 'Interior Elevation E', 7'-6" tied to North Bedroom).
